entities.summary: Great Lakes, a notable figure in the history of Uganda, associated with Great Lakes Kingdoms (1000–1800). Preceded by Bunyoro Kitara Empire. Their legacy influenced Rise of Buganda Kingdom and Ankole and Toro Kingdoms.
